claims.claim: 2DCONV, 3DCONV and particlefilter_naive retain most or all DTC speedup without Hash; changing Hash is not an isolated explanation for their cross-design gains.
2DCONV CH/DH is 3.347255x despite only 0.767% lower L2 read payload and identical DRAM read payload; traffic volume reduction alone is insufficient as an explanation.
For 2DCONV and 3DCONV, traditional repeated MSHR merge rejection and DTC deep pending-reference merging/OO completion accompany speedup; their individual causal shares are not isolated.

3MM/GEMM Hash-controlled DM->DH reduces Tag replacements and lower requests approximately 79-81% and cycles 23-24%; zero DRAM read atoms in all four cells ties this control to on-chip traffic/model behavior.

The CH and DH timing/throughput service implementations differ: CH uses pipelined 20-stage L1 bank queues; OO loads bypass those queues and use explicit Tag/notification/gather/retirement quotas. These are composite designs, not an equal-service or area-matched isolation of Tag/Data decoupling.

A shorter DTC hit/completion pipeline rather than structural ownership advantages explains a specified fraction of the observed speedup. No matched-service timing ablation exists in the frozen quartet.

particlefilter_naive gains 1.329003x with exactly zero Hash gain, zero traditional MSHR merge-full events, and zero DTC Tag replacements; neither Hash nor the recorded MSHR merge limit nor Tag-replacement retention can account for that result on their own.

Conventional throughput is underestimated or DTC service is overestimated relative to physical V100 hardware. Different service implementations establish a validation risk, not proof of either modeling error.
The counter named DTC_L1_nonexclusive_mshr_merge_full_cycles is printed from aggregated failed-access events, not a union of unique blocked cycles; it must not be subtracted from GPU cycles.

In DH 2DCONV, only 12 deferred reclaims accompany 1,885,986 Tag evictions; physical retention after Tag eviction is not frequently exercised in this hashed result. This does not remove benefits of pending merge or independent Tag/Data ownership.

missing_evidence.reason: No original experiment holds all CH/DH service timing, geometry, pending capacities and ordering policies equal.
Not printed for this original finite OO scope; absence is unknown, not zero.
Aggregated ready-to-complete service counters exist for DTC loads only and exclude earlier Tag/network/DRAM delays. No directly aligned CH distribution.

missing_evidence.item: 2DCONV whole-trace address-reuse and real cross-SM temporal order
missing_evidence.reason: Shared producer provides bounded static prefix only. Static stream order is not simulated temporal order.

missing_evidence.item: Physical PPA and realistic Tag lookup/collector implementation
missing_evidence.reason: No equal-area, technology-calibrated timing or silicon validation.
